title: From Macron's original promise to the unraveling of an ideal
subhead: 'The Macron Years' (1/3). After ten years in power, Macron's movement, which emerged as an attractive mirage amid the barren political landscape of 2017, has turned into a fiasco. Those close to the president, who experienced their movement's self-dissolution firsthand, bitterly examine their track record, something Macron refuses to discuss.

France faces historic purchasing power crisis: Since 2024, families have lost €1,200/year on average
subhead: Real wages have been falling since 2019 – a rare phenomenon – but, for a long time, social transfers and income from assets made up for it. In 2025 and 2026, that is no longer the case. As a result, average purchasing power fell over two consecutive years, something that only happened twice since 1960.

title: Macron calls antisemitic allegations against Bardella 'extremely serious'
subhead: The French president was addressing allegations that the far-right leader made antisemitic remarks in 2013. Jordan Bardella hit back, stating that he had marched at a rally against antisemitism in Paris following the October 2023 Hamas attacks on Israel, unlike Macron.

title: US Court stays Christa Pike execution
subhead: In 1995, the American woman was convicted of torturing and murdering her classmate, Colleen Slemmer, in Knoxville when she was 18. After spending 30 years on death row, she was scheduled to be killed by pentobarbital injection on Wednesday.
